title: feat(spec)!: retire the never-consumed CurrencyValueSchema / CurrencyValue export (ADR-0104 D1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBKtW8fybSYYTNn9GAARes3G)_
Fixes #27182

Ruling-ref: 6465431966
Claim: 6467480691
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — REASON: no authoring surface. `git grep CurrencyValue -- skills` on base finds only the generated `skills/*/references/_index.md` export lists (regenerated here by `gen:skill-refs`, which now name `UniqueScopeSchema` in its place); no rule, example or table teaches the shape.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 删除 `field.zod.ts` 仍导出的 `CurrencyValueSchema` 与 `CurrencyValue` 类型；登记 `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[18]` 的 `data/CurrencyValue` 与 D3 语义条目 `currency-value-schema-retired`（FROM `{value, currency}` → 裸数字，币种写在 `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency`）。
- **为什么改：** ADR-0104 D1 早已裁定删除，18.2.0 仍导出；多币种史诗 #8345 开工前必须清掉，免得作者把它当成「记录币种」的形状。
- **风险与回滚：** 零读者（只剩自身测试和生成基线），运行时行为不变；只影响 TypeScript 导入（TS2305）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.currency-value-schema-retired.ts`、`packages/spec/src/data/currency-value-retirement.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `git grep -n CurrencyValueSchema -- packages ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` → 只剩登记条目、退役 pin 和散文；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project repo src/data/currency-value-retirement.test.ts` 全绿。
- **需要您做的：** 本 PR 触及 Tier H（`docs/adr/0104`、生成的 `skills/*/references/_index.md`），按治理需 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 的批准，之后由席位落地。

## What changes

- **Spec (`@objectstack/spec`, minor, BREAKING for TypeScript imports only).** `CurrencyValueSchema` and `export type CurrencyValue` are deleted from `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`. Route 3 of the `spec-property-retirement` kit (the `ApiKeySchema` and document-family precedent): no carrier key and no metadata type ever held the shape, so there is no `retiredKey()` tombstone, no `UNKNOWN_KEY_GUIDANCE` entry and no D2 conversion.
- **ADR-0087: registered.** `retired-defs/18.data__CurrencyValue.ts` and the D3 semantic entry `semantic/18.currency-value-schema-retired.ts`, which carries the card's note: a currency value is a bare number (`{ value: 1000.5, currency: 'USD' }` → `1000.5`), the code is `currencyConfig: { currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency: 'USD' }`, and `valueSchemaFor(field, 'stored')` types a value. No `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (the `identity-api-key-schema-retired` precedent has none).
- **Generated.** `json-schema.manifest/data.json` loses `data/CurrencyValue` and `authorable-surface/data.json` its two rows (both deliberate, as the build's manifest and gate (a) deletion checks require); `api-surface`, `export-origins`, `declaration-map`, the reference docs, the strictness-ledger counts (`data/` 165 → 164 sites, `field.zod.ts` 14 → 13) and `skills/*/references/_index.md` regenerated by `check:generated --fix`. `authorable-surface.base.json` (the released anchor) is untouched.
- **Liveness / ledger.** `CurrencyValue` never had a liveness-ledger row (never walked). The strictness-ledger `field.zod.ts` row is re-graded with a dated note: `CurrencyValueSchema` deleted, `LocationCoordinatesSchema` the one site left under the existing verdict; the #8562 follow-up line now says one.
- **ADR-0104 (Tier H).** A dated note under the "Reality wins" paragraph: the deletion landed in this PR, and where the FROM → TO note lives.
- **Pins that move.** `field.test.ts` drops its `CurrencyValueSchema` block; `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` drops `Iso_data_field__CurrencyValueSchema` and its census goes 798 → 797 (title, header, `toHaveLength` with the history line). The `field-value.zod.ts` docblock now says the object shape is deleted.
- **New pin** `packages/spec/src/data/currency-value-retirement.test.ts` (added to `vitest.repo-tests.json`): the def and D3 entry are registered; the export is gone from `/data` and the root entry, `CurrencyConfigSchema` survives (lit control); `valueSchemaFor({ type: 'currency' })` accepts `1000.5` and refuses `{ value, currency }`; tree-scoped absence over the declared radius with an anti-vacuity matcher test.

## Why

ADR-0104 D1 decided "`currency` is a scalar number — `CurrencyValueSchema` is deleted", but the export shipped through 18.2.0 as `@deprecated`. The multi-currency epic #8345 (shape C′, ruling 6465431966 on #27119) needs it gone first, so that no author or AI reads `{value, currency}` as the way a record keeps its currency.

## Verification

Base `origin/main` `fd73f2b39`; head `bf9ae4435`.

<details><summary>Measure first (base)</summary>

`git grep -n CurrencyValue` outside CHANGELOGs: `field.zod.ts` (declaration and alias), `field.test.ts`, the `Iso_` pin row, `api-surface` / `export-origins` / `declaration-map` / `json-schema.manifest` / `authorable-surface` / `authorable-surface.base.json`, generated reference docs, and prose (`field-value.zod.ts` docblock, `field-value.test.ts` test name, `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx`, ADR-0104, the strictness ledger). Nothing under `ui/` or `skills/**` rules. Control: `CurrencyConfigSchema` has live readers (validator, formula, ui i18n).
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` → exit 0 (after the deliberate manifest and authorable-surface deletions; the build refused each first, as designed).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` → 14 of 14 fresh after `--fix`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` → Test Files 740 passed | 1 skipped (741), Tests 22240 passed | 1 skipped | 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` → Test Files 82 passed (82), Tests 1331 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` → exit 0.
- `check:liveness`, `check:empty-state`, `check:exported-any`, `check:dual-source-exports` → exit 0. `check:skill-examples` → exit 3 (prerequisite: needs a full-repo build; not measured).
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` → ✓ `registered currency-value-schema-retired (new here)`.
- `check-changeset-no-major` (pull_request event) → ✓ narrowing ships `minor`; `check-spec-parsed-alias` → 797 pinned, OK; `check-cross-package-test-inputs`, `check-doc-authoring`, `check-role-word`, `check-skills-token-ratchet` → OK.
</details>

## Serial note

Seat 3's #27218 (#27157) narrows `CurrencyConfigSchema` about 30 lines above this edit in `field.zod.ts` and touches `migrations/registry.ts.template`. Whichever lands second merges main (no rebase) and re-runs the generated files.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
